messages:
zara.l: Hi all, just joined today! Need a quick map: who do I ping for VPN, model-serving test access, and hardware shipping? Also want the escalation chain for prod incidents so I can shadow on-call next week.

claire.devex: Welcome @zara.l! For repo/Slack invites DM me your GitHub handle. VPN and infra access: file a ticket in #eng-infra.

infra-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-6123 by zara.l (onboarding access)  assigned to eng-infra. ETA 1 business day.

mike.p: Model-serving and runtime questions -> eng-runtime (me and team). For test GPUs, open an infra request and tag @mike.p and include workload + duration. Short trials (<8h) usually approved quickly.

ben.sre: Escalation chain: page oncall -> owning service lead -> platform/SRE -> EMs -> CTO-on-call for P0. Oncall rotation is here: https://go/redwood/oncall-schedule. If you
re shadowing, read the incident runbook chapter 2 first.

olivia.hr: Hi Zara, welcome! Sending the hardware form and payroll checklist now. New hire orientation at 09:30 tomorrow in #all-hands.

zara.l: Thanks everyone. One nit: who signs off Dedicated capacity for short experiments?

mike.p: Eng-platform signs off for ad-hoc small reservations. For anything longer or repeated, it goes via finance + product infra. DM me if you want me to fast-track one-off test.

claire.devex: I'll add you to the owners summary doc and drop a short who-to-cc list in DM. Also check this owners snapshot: https://go/redwood/owners-snapshot.

zara.l: Perfect, appreciate it!
